title: A2A structured handoff request
description: Issue #2050: structured handoff request contract for POST /api/a2a. source_event_seq is the source pipeline segment seq. Callers SHOULD send it explicitly (top-level preferred, payload.* accepted); when omitted the server derives it from the caller session (source task event_seq), keeping structured handoff the primary trigger source while text A2A lines remain a readable fallback.

agent.description: Target agent. Built-in roles are vod/issue/coding/qa/sre; custom scene pipelines may target any node tag — the scene nodes list is the single source of truth (POST /api/a2a validates against it, not against a fixed enum).

issue_number.description: Numeric issue number (integer or digit string) or a letter-based ident (D102-G).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key, e.g. handoff:{task_id}:{target_agent}. Same (repo_key, key) returns the existing event. Issue #2248: fix rounds SHOULD use a round/head-sha based key, e.g. issue-<N>-a2a-qa-r<round>-<sha7>.

source_event_seq.description: Source pipeline segment seq (top-level, preferred). Falls back to the caller session's event_seq server-side.

force.description: Issue #1942: bypass downstream_running / duplicate_key / active_dispatch gates. Issue #2248: when idempotency_key hits a terminal event (completed/failed/cancelled/timeout), force=true also bypasses the idempotency short-circuit and creates a new event under a derived round key; an active hit still returns the existing event. Top-level force and payload.force=true are equivalent.
